id: 09_Replace the Switched-Mode Power Supply for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机开关电源的规范更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/09_Replace the Switched-Mode Power Supply for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/09_Replace the Switched-Mode Power Supply for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.S3: 绝缘手套和工具用前检查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实训车间里一台带轮子的激光焊接机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a university workshop next to a gray wheeled cabinet-type laser welding machine with a handheld welding gun, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机里的电源怎样规范更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机开关电源的规范更换

shots.scene: 四个图标：报修单、断电插头、电压表、扳手
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blank repair request form, an unplugged power plug, a voltage tester and a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 先报修，再断电验电，最后按步骤换。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下焊机开关，屏幕不亮，他皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the power switch of the laser welding machine; its blank display stays dark and he frowns.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊机开不了机，屏幕不亮。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着螺丝刀想打开机箱侧门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a screwdriver and reaches for the side door of the machine cabinet.
shots.narration: 他想自己拆开看看哪里坏了。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向墙上的电话和报修单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points to a wall phone and a blank repair request form on a board.
shots.narration: 小研拦住：焊机里有高压，先报修。

shots.scene: 老李提着工具箱走来，戴上绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks in carrying a toolbox and puts on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 设备管理老师请来了专业维修人员老李。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张黄黑边框的警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 厂家写明：这类维修只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 学生拿螺丝刀拆机箱的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student opening a machine cabinet with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 非专业人员，严禁擅自拆机。

shots.scene: 老李把焊机电源开关拨到关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the main power switch of the laser welding machine to off.
shots.narration: 动手之前，第一步永远是断电。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机器里有高电压，也有强激光。

shots.scene: 手部触电和烧伤的图标
shots.prompt_en: Two warning icons side by side: a hand with a lightning bolt and a hand with a flame burn mark. No people.
shots.narration: 处理不当，会触电、烧伤，甚至更严重。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个电源模块上还闪着闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one power module still shows a glowing lightning bolt icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：拔了电，电源里还可能有高压。

shots.scene: 沙漏放在焊机旁
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass stands on the floor beside the closed laser welding machine. No people.
shots.narration: 要按说明书规定等待，才能碰内部。

shots.scene: 老李双手戴着厚绝缘手套，举起给镜头看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up both hands wearing thick insulated gloves toward the camera.
shots.narration: 整个维修过程，都要戴绝缘手套。

shots.section_title: 绝缘手套和工具用前检查
shots.scene: 老李对着光检查绝缘手套，再卷起袖口看有没有漏气
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds his insulated gloves up to the light, then rolls the cuff to check for air leaks.
shots.narration: 手套用前查破损、查漏气。
overlay: 绝缘手套和工具用前检查

shots.section_title: 绝缘手套和工具用前检查
shots.scene: 螺丝刀绝缘柄有裂纹的图标被打叉，完好的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two screwdriver icons: one with a cracked insulated handle crossed out with a red X, one intact with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 工具绝缘柄有裂纹，就换掉不用。

shots.section_title: 绝缘手套和工具用前检查
shots.scene: 手套和工具上的绝缘等级标志特写，标志处空白
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank insulation rating mark on a glove cuff and on a screwdriver handle. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘等级要合要求，以现行标准为准。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把一字螺丝刀和一个新电源模块
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers of different sizes, one flat-head screwdriver and a new blank gray rail-mounted power supply module. No people.
shots.narration: 备好大小两把十字刀、一把一字刀。

shots.scene: 老李核对新电源和旧电源的空白铭牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer compares the blank nameplate of the new power supply module with a blank parts list.
shots.narration: 备件要用规格一致的原厂配件。

shots.scene: 焊机背面接口全部空着，电源线和焊枪线放在一边
shots.prompt_en: The back of the laser welding machine with all sockets empty; the unplugged power cable and the welding gun cable lie coiled on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 确认电源线、焊枪线等全部断开。

shots.scene: 老李关闭气瓶阀门的手部特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the facility engineer's gloved hand closing the valve of a shielding gas cylinder.
shots.narration: 接着的保护气也先关好。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套踩下焊机脚轮的刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel of the laser welding machine with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住，机器不会滑动。

shots.scene: 焊机静静放着，旁边时钟指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The closed laser welding machine stands still while a wall clock beside it shows time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 静置一段时间，让机器放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 说明书翻开在等待时间那一页，页面空白只有沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: An open blank instruction manual with only an hourglass icon on the page, lying on top of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 等多久，以说明书规定为准。

shots.scene: 电源模块示意图，内部画着一个大电容图标，上面有闪电
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a power supply module with a large capacitor icon inside and a lightning bolt above it. No people.
shots.narration: 电源里的大电容，断电后还存着电。

shots.scene: 老李戴绝缘手套，用电压测试仪测模块输出端，表盘空白
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in insulated gloves measures the output terminals of the power module with a voltage tester; its screen is blank.
shots.narration: 等待之后，用合格仪表测一下端子。

shots.scene: 电压表图标打勾，沙漏图标旁边打问号
shots.prompt_en: A voltage tester icon with a green check mark next to an hourglass icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确认无电再动手，不凭感觉凭测量。

shots.scene: 手指直接碰端子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare finger touching a terminal, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 任何时候，都不用手去试有没有电。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊机左侧的门板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the hinged left side door of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 打开机器左侧的门板。

shots.scene: 门内是送丝机安装板，老李用十字螺丝刀拧螺钉
shots.prompt_en: Inside the door is a black wire feeder mounting plate; the facility engineer removes its screws one by one with a cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 用大十字刀拆下安装板周边的螺钉。

shots.scene: 一个小盒子里装着拆下的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: A small parts tray on the workbench holding the removed screws. No people.
shots.narration: 一共十四颗，放进零件盒别弄丢。

shots.scene: 老李用小十字刀拆黄绿色接地线的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a small cross-head screwdriver to remove the screw holding a yellow-green earth wire on the plate.
shots.narration: 再用小十字刀拆下接地线的螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李把安装板向外放平，露出机内的接线和模块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer carefully lays the mounting plate outward, revealing neat wiring and blank electrical modules inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 把安装板轻轻放平，露出里面的电气区。

shots.scene: 小研用手机给电源接线拍照
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a photo of the power module wiring with a blank phone.
shots.narration: 拆线之前，先拍照留底。

shots.scene: 每根导线套上不同颜色的小标签
shots.prompt_en: Each wire gets a small colored tag clipped near its end. No people.
shots.narration: 每根线贴上标签，装回时不会接错。

shots.scene: 老李戴上防静电腕带，夹在机壳上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on an antistatic wrist strap and clips its cord to the metal frame of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 要碰电路板，先做好防静电。

shots.scene: 空白电路板放在防静电袋上
shots.prompt_en: A blank circuit board resting on a pink antistatic bag on the workbench. No people.
shots.narration: 拆下的板件放在防静电袋上。

shots.scene: 老李从主控板上拔下红黑两色的供电线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs a red and black power cable connector from the main control board.
shots.narration: 从主控板上拔下电源的供电线。

shots.scene: 导轨上的灰色电源模块，老李拧下固定螺钉
shots.prompt_en: A gray power supply module on a silver mounting rail; the facility engineer removes its fixing screw with a cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 拧下电源模块的固定螺钉。

shots.scene: 一字螺丝刀插进模块底部卡扣，轻轻撬起
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a flat-head screwdriver inserted into the clip at the bottom of the module, gently levering it off the rail.
shots.narration: 用一字刀撬开卡扣，从导轨上取下。

shots.scene: 老李手持旧电源，拧松端子螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the old power supply module and loosens its terminal screws.
shots.narration: 拧松四个端子螺丝。

shots.scene: 四根线拔出，旧模块放到一边
shots.prompt_en: Four wires are pulled out of the terminals and the old module is set aside on the workbench.
shots.narration: 拔下四根线，取下旧电源。

shots.scene: 老李从包装中取出新的电源模块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes a new blank gray power supply module out of its box.
shots.narration: 取出新电源。

shots.scene: 四根线插入新模块端子，螺丝刀拧紧
shots.prompt_en: Four wires are inserted into the terminals of the new module and tightened with a small screwdriver.
shots.narration: 四根线插回对应端子，逐个拧紧。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一张参考图，图上四个端子用不同颜色圆点标出
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a reference diagram showing four terminals marked with colored dots beside the new module.
shots.narration: 接线顺序，必须和参考图一模一样。

shots.scene: 接错线冒火花的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of crossed wires producing a spark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接反接错，通电就可能烧坏设备。

shots.scene: 老李逐根轻拉导线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently tugs each wire at the terminals one by one.
shots.narration: 每根线轻轻一拉，确认没有松动。

shots.scene: 新模块底部卡进银色导轨
shots.prompt_en: The new module's bottom clip is hooked onto the silver mounting rail and pressed into place.
shots.narration: 把新电源底部卡进银色导轨。

shots.scene: 插回主控板供电线，再拧紧固定螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs the power cable back into the main control board, then tightens the fixing screw of the module.
shots.narration: 接回主控板供电线，拧紧固定螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李抬起安装板，把送丝电机线插回主控板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the mounting plate back up and plugs the wire feeder motor cable into the main control board.
shots.narration: 抬回安装板，接好送丝电机线。

shots.scene: 接地线螺钉拧紧，周边螺钉逐一装回
shots.prompt_en: The yellow-green earth wire screw is tightened, then the screws around the plate are refitted one by one.
shots.narration: 接地线一定装回，螺钉全部拧上。

shots.scene: 万用表测接地线端和机壳之间的通断，表盘空白，绿灯亮
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter with a blank screen tests continuity between the yellow-green earth wire end and the metal cabinet frame; a green light turns on. No people.
shots.narration: 接地线装回后，测一测是否导通。

shots.scene: 接地线松脱时机壳带电的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine cabinet with a loose earth wire and a lightning bolt on the case, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 漏接接地线，机壳漏电就会伤人。

shots.scene: 老李清点工具，零件盒空了，关上门板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer counts his tools, shows an empty parts tray, and closes the side door.
shots.narration: 清点工具螺钉，机内不留异物。

shots.scene: 旧电源放进贴有回收图标的收集箱
shots.prompt_en: The old power supply module is placed into a collection box marked with a recycling icon. No people.
shots.narration: 换下的旧电源，交回统一回收处置。

shots.scene: 旧电路板扔进普通垃圾桶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an old circuit board thrown into an ordinary trash bin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电子废件不混进生活垃圾。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons floating behind: a wrench, a voltage tester, an antistatic wrist strap and an earth symbol.
shots.narration: 专业人员维修，断电等待，测量确认。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 拍照标记，按图接线，接地查导通。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老李、小研、阿杰在焊机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 设备会坏，规矩不能坏。下次见！
